evidence: verify_strohacker_2024_arms_readiness.R (live table: 5190 rows, 22 persons, 519 session reports). IDENTITY: codes are the S1 workbook column names, self-describing abbreviations each matching exactly one of the ten wordings the paper quotes (10/10), with the workbook descriptor row naming the same five pairs as the paper's factors; this is what distinguishes every item from every other. (A) route 6 polarity, pooled r: fatigue-worded items (PhysTired, PhysSpent, MentalTired, CantFocus) intercorrelate +0.43..+0.84, readiness-worded items +0.40..+0.72, fatigue x readiness -0.73..-0.33 (all 24 cross pairs negative) -- the polarity class of all 10 items matches its wording and shows the data are raw. (B) route 5 within-person (person-mean-centred) pair structure: designated partner r vs best other same-polarity item r: PhysFresh-FeelFIt 0.63 vs 0.42/0.36; PhysSpent-PhysTired 0.75 vs 0.39/0.38; FocusWell-ThinkClear 0.63 vs 0.48/0.58; MentalTired-CantFocus 0.48 vs 0.39/0.32; HandleFeels-UnderControl 0.55 vs ThinkClear 0.56/0.58 (near-ties) -- 8/10 strongest partner is the designated one. NOT established by the statistics: they cannot tell the two items within any pair apart (e.g. PhysSpent vs PhysTired, MentalTired vs CantFocus), and do not separate the threat-challenge pair from ThinkClear; on their own they would be PARTIAL. VERIFIED rests on the self-describing-code exemption, which the statistics corroborate but do not replace.
